اختتما (form VIII)
# اِخْتَتَمَا (iḵtatamā) /ix.ta.ta.maː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِخْتَتَمَ (iḵtatama)
# اُخْتُتِمَا (uḵtutimā) /ux.tu.ti.maː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِخْتَتَمَ (iḵtatama)
# اِخْتَتِمَا (iḵtatimā) /ix.ta.ti.maː/: second-person dual imperative of اِخْتَتَمَ (iḵtatama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
